76: void Logger::run() {
77:     while (true) {
78:         std::queue<LogEntry> local_queue;
79: 
80:         {
81:             std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
82:             this->condition.wait(
83:                 lock, [this] { return this->stop || !this->queue.empty(); });
84: 
85:             if (this->stop && this->queue.empty()) {
86:                 return;
87:             }
88: 
89:             local_queue.swap(this->queue);

92:         while (!local_queue.empty()) {
93:             const auto& entry = local_queue.front();
94:             auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
95:             std::string date = Logger::date_string(now);
96:             this->rotate_if_needed(date);
97: 
98:             if (this->output.is_open()) {
99:                 this->output << Logger::timestamp_string(now) << " ["
100:                              << Logger::level_name(entry.level)
101:                              << "]: " << entry.message << '\n';
102:                 ++this->current_line_count;
